## Result

Problem 30000347 / OWR-1111-001, rank 962: **claimed_solved, 1/5 substantive proof-attempt turns**.

The full proof establishes NP-completeness of undirected unit-length three-terminal Blocking Shortest Paths, even when all deletion costs are 1 and every original terminal distance is 3. Exact optimization is NP-hard. The positive binary-encoded rational-cost case and optional finite-terminal-distance / exact 3-to-4 strengthening are addressed explicitly.

## Mathematical acceptance

Two independent full-proof audits accepted the identical frozen manuscript with no required mathematical corrections. Both checked the primary-source model and reconstructed both directions of the Vertex Cover reduction. Arbitrary middle-edge deletions, the complete shortest-path family, polynomial input/budget encoding, edgeless cases, zero budgets, and NP membership are treated explicitly.

The proof, historical manifests, source/model assessment, original source-free author archive, full audit reports, independent checkers and recorded results are preserved. Historical pre-audit status language remains unchanged and is superseded by the publication acceptance report.

- Frozen proof SHA-256: f31b19b8e4286e0104ed1e272f5cbc4a39e20aea78aa30334466f5b44e5830f7
- Frozen manifest SHA-256: b13c9cee3e806a263ba0e24b2838599692727ea48d26977d4fca714e1e30d273
- Publication manifest SHA-256: 63c6c812054a38c98780afd938f2dd409baf65f4ef88a0511f31c06bc3a09274

## Reproduction and scope

Standard-library, source-free reproduction passes all three mathematical suites in normal and optimized Python. The 100 integrity mutation controls fail closed. These computations supplement the written universal proof; they do not substitute for it. All 26 committed files, including the narrow queue update, were read back byte-for-byte.

Based on main 0d5ae675f8a51e0eaead04d0bf20cdce3f182c8d. The queue edit changes only this target's Status, Turns and Findings cells; every unrelated row, cell, note and existing chat link is preserved. No copied source PDF, image, source text, dataset contents, private source or coordination material is included.

This is AI-assisted research and independent AI-assisted mathematical review. No novelty, priority, exhaustive current-literature, human-peer-review, journal-acceptance or formal-certification claim is made. The directed case was already known in the historical source; the accepted target here is undirected. No planar, bounded-degree, weighted-traversal-length or globally connected residual-graph result is claimed.

**Draft only. No merge, release or DOI.**

Start at [the packet README](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/d67d11bcb7d1e730daf9be7555c75950d3484b5d/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30000347/README.md).
